semantics.segment_orientation: Literal OSM way coordinate orientation; route member order is not independently verified traversal. No segment reordered/reversed/stitched.
semantics.connectivity: Components union segments sharing an EXACT coordinate vertex. This is a coordinate diagnostic, not a node-ID/routability/layer/turn-restriction graph. An unvertexed crossing is not connected by this test.
semantics.endpoint_discontinuities: Dynamic programming counts minimum nonmatching adjacent endpoint joins when segment reversal is allowed for the diagnostic only. No inferred traversal or repaired geometry is produced.
semantics.distances: Great-circle separation of nearest segment endpoints, metres. Measurements are not connectors or toleranced snapping.
semantics.roles: Raw route-member roles, not one-way road tags.
